VD_extras: At 9:22 a.m. all prospective jurors were sworn for voir dire; at 9:27 a.m. Court read the Juror Code of Conduct and the stipulated statement of claims and defenses before voir dire by Court began at 9:54 a.m. After the recess, at 11:14 a.m. prospective jurors were present and peremptory challenges were exercised before 11:18 a.m. when eight jurors were selected, immediately preceding the 11:19 a.m. swearing.

Verdict_note: Titan (plaintiff) prevailed on breach of contract and breach of implied duty of good faith and fair dealing claims. National Tax (defendant/counterclaim plaintiff) did not prevail on any counterclaims except unjust enrichment (Q16 Yes), but the amount awarded for unjust enrichment (Q17) appears to be $1 or illegible. Titan's total damages ($1,027,500 + $10,200) far exceed any counterclaim award.
